name: skopeo
description: Container image inspection and manipulation tool without requiring a container runtime

tools.description: Inspect, copy, and manage container images across registries without Docker daemon
tools.usage:
skopeo inspect docker://alpine:latest # Inspect remote image
skopeo copy docker://alpine:latest oci:./alpine # Copy to local OCI format
skopeo list-tags docker://nginx # List available tags
skopeo delete docker://registry.com/image:tag # Delete remote image
skopeo sync --src docker --dest dir registry.com/repo ./backup # Sync images
